description: This file contains unit tests for the CustomerService class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It sets up test cases to verify methods like saving customers, retrieving all customers, and fetching a customer by ID, using mocking techniques to simulate dependencies.

classes.name: CustomerServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for CustomerService, verifying customer-related operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating a CustomerService instance and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testSaveCustomer
methods.description: Tests saving a Customer object using a mocked CustomerDao.

methods.name: testGetAllCustomer
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of all Customers based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetCustomerById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Customer by its ID.
